name: export_shape
description: Exports a shape (or a shape's image fill) from the Penpot design to a PNG or SVG image, such that you can get an impression of what it looks like. Alternatively, you can save it to a file when file system access is enabled on the server.

shapeId.description: Identifier of the shape to export. Use the special identifier 'selection' to export the first shape currently selected by the user.

mode.description: Export mode: 'shape' (full shape including descendants) or 'fill' (raw image fill; PNG only).

filePath.description: Optional absolute file path to save the export.
